Statistics of [[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]] in the 1999&ndash;2000 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 18 teams, and [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray S.K.]] won the championship. And demotion of [[Altay S.K.]], [[Göztepe A.Ş.]], [[Vanspor]] was decided.
